name: gizza-ai/mac-address-format
summary: Reformat MAC addresses between colon, hyphen, Cisco, and bare styles

tool.description: Reformat one or many MAC addresses (EUI-48 and EUI-64) between colon, hyphen, Cisco dotted-quad, and bare hex notations with a chosen hex case. Input may be in any notation; order is preserved and duplicates kept.

input.description: One or more MAC addresses to reformat, in any notation. Separate with whitespace, commas, or newlines.
